articleTitle: Coherent Optics for Data Center Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Coherent technology has been widely used in metro data center networks, and will penetrate into shorter links and even intra-data center interconnects for beyond-400G networks due to its sensitivity and impairment compensation capability. Various techniques are discussed to reduce the complexity and power consumption for coherent optics.

articleTitle: Coherent Access: Status and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Coherent technology has the potential to be a disruptive technology for access networks. However, deployment of coherent-access remains challenging due to its higher complexity and power-consumption compared with conventional approaches. Herein we review present research status on reduced-complexity coherent PON and outline the future opportunities.

articleTitle: Field Usable Fusion Splicing Technique for Multicore Fiber
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Fusion splice of a 5 core MCF is demonstrated using a field usable compact, lightweight, battery driven fusion splicer. Average splice loss of 0.12 dB/splice is obtained by automated alignment function of the splicer.

articleTitle: Digital Coherent DSP based PON Technology for Ultimate Capacity Optical Access Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We review the latest progress in Tbit/s-class Passive Optical Network (PON) technology based on recent Digital Coherent DSP for emerging Beyond-5G/6G era ultimate capacity optical access systems.

Author Keywords: Coherent DSP based Optical Access System

articleTitle: Photonic Reservoir Computing in Optical Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Hardware-based reservoir computing offers an alternative approach to conventional digital signal processing. Here two different types of photonic reservoir computers are evaluated with respect to their equalization performance in optical transmission systems. Feasibility and problems are also analyzed and possible solutions are discussed.

articleTitle: Applications for Spatial Divison Multiplexing Fiber and Associated Cost Per Bit
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Spatial Division Multiplexing (SDM) could potentially address optical density and cable capacity challenges in data center and subsea networks. In co-packaged optics, the multicore fiber (MCF) offers up to 3X higher density than regular fiber solution; In long haul submarine networks, however, single core fiber based SDM solution will provide overall lower cost per bit than MCF.

articleTitle: Investigation of Inter-Modal Four Wave Mixing in p-i-n Diode Assisted SOI Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Usage of multi mode SOI Waveguides including a p-i-n diode is proposed for inter-modal FWM. Devices have been designed, fabricated and characterized. An efficiency improvement of 4.2 dB is demonstrated by adding the diode and reverse bias. Crosstalk is identified as main challenge for integration.

articleTitle: Power-Efficient ASIC Implementation of DSP Algorithms for Coherent Optical Communication
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Coherent optical communication critically relies on efficient digital signal processing (DSP). We outline the application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) implementation flow for DSP algorithms and discuss approaches to reducing the digital ASIC power dissipation of high-throughput DSP implementations for coherent fiber-optic communication systems.

articleTitle: Influence of Electrical Noise on Temporal Optical Phase Reconstruction Using Transport-of-Intensity Equation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Non-iterative temporal phase reconstruction of high-speed optical signals in direct detection based on solving transport-of-intensity equation is studied. It is shown that direct solution of TIE using simple forward difference approximation is sensitive to electrical noise at detection.

articleTitle: Extending Phase Noise Tolerance in UDWDM Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Geometrically shaped constellations, designed for improved AWGN channel performance, are combined with enhanced symbol decision metrics for low symbol rate/high linewidth applications, e.g., ultra-dense wavelength division multiplexed passive optical networks (UDWDM-PON). The improved metric enables 32-ary constellation transmission with robustness to AWGN and phase noise.

articleTitle: Optical Amplification Efficiency Improvement of Multicore EDFA by Using Turbo Cladding Pumping Scheme
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: For C band application, the optical amplification efficiency of cladding pumped multicore EDFA is still problematic as a major part of the pump light is not absorbed in the short doped fiber. In this paper, we study the pump recycling technology. The operation principle is introduced and verified experimentally. Also, fundamental optical amplification performance is characterized. Moreover, feasibility of the application to multicore optical transmission systems is researched.

articleTitle: Challenges in Modelling Optical Fibres for Spatial Division Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We review recent studies of the nonlinear interference in spatial division multiplexing systems. Different solution methods of the multimode Schrödinger equation are compared, highlighting the accuracy of a stochastic solution method including distributed mode coupling.

articleTitle: Further development potential of photonic ADCs under contention among error terms in SNR
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Photonics could offer a potential for high performance ADCs in high-end segments to pursue further development. We revisit ADC's SNR to examine what is effective to approximate it to an ideal one of being constrained by the trade-off condition between sampling rate and resolution.

articleTitle: Co-Sputtered Monocrystalline GeSn for Infrared Photodetection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate monocrystalline growth of GeSn on Ge and Si substrates by co-sputtering. We discuss the evolution of film growth with thickness, elucidating the effects of substrate temperature, sputtering source, and the importance of hydrogen dilution in the plasma.

articleTitle: Multi-scale theory and simulation of direct-gap group-IV semiconductor alloys
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Alloying of Ge with other group-IV elements - C, Sn or Pb - represents a promising route to realise direct-gap group-IV semiconductors for applications in Si-compatible devices, including light-emitting diodes and lasers, as well as tunnelling field-effect transistors and multi-junction solar cells. To develop a quantitative understanding of the properties and potential of group-IV alloys, we have established a multi-scale simulation framework to enable predictive analysis of their structural and electronic properties. We provide an overview of these simulation capabilities, and describe previously overlooked fundamental aspects of the electronic structure evolution and indirect- to direct-gap transition in (Si)Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>(C, Sn, Pb)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> alloys. We further describe ongoing work related to exploiting this simulation platform to compute the optical and transport properties of (Si)Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>Sn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> alloys and heterostructures.

articleTitle: Space-Division Multiplexing fibers for radiofrequency signal processing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Beyond high-capacity transmission, space-division multiplexing fibers can be engineered to provide distributed signal processing for microwave signals. We present an overview of different fiber technologies where the incorporation of the space dimension brings advantages in terms of compactness as well as operation flexibility and versatility.

articleTitle: Ultra-Compact Tunable Multi-Mode Converter based on Tilted Bragg Gratings in SOI Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We propose an elite mode converter using a tilted contra-directional Bragg grating in SOI strip waveguide, with merits of a compact footprint and a tunable multi-mode conversion. The device footprint is less than 10 μm, with an insertion loss less than 1 dB.

articleTitle: Robust self-test of high-dimension mutually unbiased bases with commercial multi-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We perform a robust self-testing certification of two four-dimensional mutually unbiased bases in a high-quality optical configuration built with commercial multicore fiber. We also evaluate the randomness produced. Our results represent an important step towards practical self-testing in high-dimensional quantum information technologies.

articleTitle: Dual Frequency Comb Photonic Analog to Digital Conversion
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate a performance improvement of dual-comb based optical analog-to-digital conversion methods. Through improved optical front-end design, we obtain 4.5 bits ENOB up to 12.5 GHz, representing 10 dB SINAD enhancement compared to previous results.

articleTitle: Photonics-Enhanced RF Spectrum Sensing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Spectrum sensing is of fundamental importance for interference identification and spectrum allocation in wireless communications. This talk performs an overview of recent photonics-based spectrum sensing techniques, which offer better performance in terms of bandwidth and speed that may not be achievable using traditional electronics.

articleTitle: Impact on frequency combs of nonlinearity including bleaching in p-i-n photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We calculate the impact of nonlinearity in a p-i-n photodetector on an RF-modulated frequency comb taking into account bleaching due to the large peak-to-average power ratio in frequency combs. We characterized RF-modulated frequency combs by IMD2<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>, IMD3<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>, OIP2<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>, and OIP3<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> for each comb line n.

articleTitle: FEC Implementation and Options for Short-Reach Optical Transmission
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We review FEC options for short-reach optical transmissions including staircase code, concatenated staircase and Hamming code, QC-LDPC code, and LDPC convolution code. We optimize the FEC implementations employing high-throughput FPGA emulations from the aspects of decoding buffer size, fixed-point scale factor, and error floor elimination.

articleTitle: Design of a waveguide-coupled GeSn disk laser
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We report on the design of a waveguide coupled GeSn microdisk-laser cavity in which the germanium virtual substrate serving as a template for GeSn growth is repurposed for the definition of passive on-chip interconnection waveguides.

articleTitle: Prospects of Massive Parallelism in Si-Photonic Transceivers for SDM Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The continues increase in bandwidth demands in optical communication pushes transceivers modules towards higher levels of integration and lower power consumption and cost. Spatial division multiplexing (SDM) is being seen as the solution to bridge the gap between data generation and transport. We review the current status for photonic integration and outline the prospects of SDM and photonic integration combined for future opportunities.

articleTitle: Multiple Order and Broadband Optical Orbital Angular Momentum Source using a Single Photonic Crystal Device
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A promising optical integrated circuit device design for the generation of broadband, low order OAM modes with topological charges of +1 and +2 is successfully conceptualized using a combination of ring and point defect in thin photonic crystal slab structure with circular array of holes.

articleTitle: Distributed sensing beyond Rayleigh scattering limits in single and multicore fiber waveguides
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Optical fibers with enhanced scattering properties can provide distributed reflection signals beyond the limits set by Rayleigh scattering in standard telecommunications fibers. Enhanced fibers can be used in lengths from one meter in shape sensing applications to more than one kilometer in distributed acoustic sensing.

articleTitle: Matrix Multiplication Unit Scalability Investigation for InP SOA-based Photonic Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We investigate the scalability of a SOA-based photonic DNN with WDM inputs. For a 3-layer DNN, a quasi-linear dependence between the prediction accuracy and errors/layer is found for a NRMSE <; 0.09. Optimized passive losses can enable synaptic function at half of the power consumption.

articleTitle: A Photonic Integrated Circuit based Compressive Sensing Radio Frequency Receiver
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A photonic integrated circuit comprised of an 11 cm multimode speckle waveguide, a 1×32 splitter, and a linear grating coupler array is fabricated and utilized to receive 2 GHz of RF signal bandwidth from 2.5 to 4.5 GHz using a 35 MHz mode locked laser.

articleTitle: Components and Amplifiers for Space Division Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We discuss advances in mode selective photonic lanterns and a coupled-core amplifier for few mode fiber transmission, characteristics such as gain and mode dependent loss are discussed.

articleTitle: Star crossed? Combining photonics and astronomy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Modern astronomical instruments tend to be expensive, massive and built on an ad hoc basis. Devices developed for photonics can replace expensive bulk optics, streamlining instrument development. Here I discuss the challenges and successes in combining photonic technologies and astronomical instrumentation.

articleTitle: Multi-Wavelength Optical Sampling with Temporal Lenticular Lens
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We investigate high-speed optical sampling based on temporal lenticular lens. In our scheme, the sampling rate is enhanced by applying multi-wavelength time-interleaved processing. The effective number of bits ranges from 4.2 to 3.5 over the frequency range of 40 - 80 GHz.

articleTitle: Development of Integrated Membrane III–V/Si DMLs for Multi-Core Fiber Transmission
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present our recent achievements on energy-efficient 400-Gb/s short-reach IMDD-SDM links and optical data-center interconnections based on our low-power-consumption membrane III-V-on-Si directly-modulated lasers over standard-cladding-diameter multi-core fiber.

articleTitle: Integrated Balanced Avalanche Photodiodes for Coherent Self-Homodyne Intra-Datacenter Links : (Invited Paper)
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A high-speed and linear balanced avalanche photodiode is presented, enabling coherent self-homodyne receivers. Such a device would reduce cost and power consumption for intra-datacenter links.

articleTitle: Spectral and Spatial Shaping of Spatiotemporal Nonlinearities in Multimode Fibers
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Single-mode optical fibers have been used for various applications such as communications, fiber lasers, optical imaging and nonlinear optics. Recently multimode fibers started to attract attention for the aforementioned applications by including the spatial degree of freedom. Specifically, in graded-index multimode fibers (GIMFs), ultrashort pulse propagation with complex modal interactions revealed new nonlinear dynamics for beam shaping, frequency conversion and ultrashort pulse generation [1 , 2] . Here, we present methods to control the spectral and spatial properties of propagating light in multimode fibers and laser cavities. The multimode fiber nonlinearities are learned and shaped with a machine learning approach for single-pass pulse propagation. In spatiotemporal mode-locked fiber lasers, complex multimode laser structures, the generation of high-quality beam shapes are reported by changing temporal dynamics of mode-locked pulses and beam profile improvement with spatiotemporal mode-locking is achieved.

articleTitle: Modelling and Optimization of Space-Division Multiplexing Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Cost and energy efficient optical amplifiers are key components for capacity increase in fiber based optical transmission systems by space division multiplexing. We focus on the scaling of the mode count in multi-mode erbium-doped fiber amplifiers, which we identified as the most promising candidate.

articleTitle: Locking Dynamics of an Analogue Coherent TDMA Receiver for Many-to-Any Network Architectures
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The locking dynamics of an analogue coherent receiver based on an externally modulated laser are investigated for on-off keyed traffic. We experimentally confirm fast all-optical locking within 10 ns and the reception of data packets with short guard interval, originating from two free-running optical transmitters.

articleTitle: 2-D photodetector array for high-data-rate spatial sampling
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: In this paper, we report on a newly developed 2D-PDA device, and its applications for carrier-less, phase retrieval coherent detection, and space diversity signal detection in free-space optical communications.

articleTitle: Novel technique for 2D temporal femtosecond laser pulses characterization
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: In this work, we present a CMOS sensor implemented for 2D-temporal characterization of femtosecond pulses, based on the Two Photon Absorption (TPA) process. We demonstrate the CMOS camera TPA capability to measure the Fringe Resolved Autocorrelation (FRAC).

articleTitle: Real-time and Single-Shot Recovery of Arbitrary Subnoise Signals
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present a passive amplification method based on the Talbot effect that allows for single-shot recovery of arbitrary signals buried under noise. The scheme can be reconfigured to operate on either narrowband or broadband signals, representing a comprehensive approach to weak, noise-dominated signal recovery.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of MIMO DSP in Weakly-coupled Few-mode Fiber Transmission
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present FPGA-implemented real-time MIMO DSP, enabling to demultiplexing two degenerate modes with dual polarization. With the real-time MIMO coherent receiver, we demonstrate weakly-coupled 10 mode multiplexed transmission experiment over 48 km few-mode fibers.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity Quasi-Coherent Reception for 100 Gb/s NGOA
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: It has already been demonstrated that quasi-coherent receivers can extend the reach of 25 Gb/s networks in the C-band. In this paper, we review the roadmap of quasi-coherent reception towards 100Gb/s NGOA based on DWDM networks and/or high line rate networks.

articleTitle: Distributed characterization of coupling in multimode and multicore fibers
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Distributed characterization of mode coupling is key to understanding the behavior of multimode and multicore fibers. This paper presents a theoretical framework that precisely assess limits and potentialities of mode-selective distributed measurements based on Rayleigh backscattering.
